title: Request scoring and preflight simulation for dedicated throughput guarantees
creator: Priya Nair
description: Create a request scoring and preflight simulation pipeline for Dedicated capacity onboarding. The feature should evaluate incoming reservation requests against fleet-level constraints, autoscale safety profiles, and probabilistic demand simulations to produce a risk score, recommended autoscale profile, and a cost/latency trade-off estimate. This will be surfaced to the provisioning console and used by the approval flow to automate low-risk requests and flag high-risk ones for manual review.
proposed_solution: 1) Implement a Request Scorer service that ingests reservation metadata (target throughput, QPS distribution, percentiles, peak windows, model family, sequence length distribution). 2) Run lightweight preflight simulations (Monte Carlo with historical workload seeds) to estimate P(on-degrade) and expected CPU/GPU utilization under 95th percentile demand. 3) Generate an autoscale signature: min/max replicas, burst allowance, cooldown windows, and expected unit cost delta. 4) Surface results via provisioning API and add gating rules in the approval workflow: auto-approve if risk_score < 0.10 and cost_delta within commit budget. 5) Store simulation artifacts for replay and audits.
acceptance_criteria: Request Scorer microservice accepts JSON reservation payload and returns a risk_score (0-1), recommended autoscale signature, and cost_delta estimation
Preflight simulation completes within 45s for typical requests (or returns an approximate fast-path estimate within 5s)
Console shows simulation summary and links to replay artifact in the provisioning review UI
Auto-approval rule executes and transitions low-risk requests to 'Provisioned' without human intervention
High-risk requests are flagged and include recommended mitigation actions (e.g., increase commit, reduce 95th pct throughput, enable larger burst pool)

decisions: Adopt two-tier simulation: fast-path analytical estimate for latency-sensitive path and asynchronous Monte Carlo for audit/tuning
Auto-approval thresholds set: risk_score < 0.10 auto-provision; 0.10-0.30 auto-provision with warning; >0.30 manual review
Include autoscale signature in provisioning API to enable conservative default fleet controls
Persist simulation artifacts for 90 days to support regressions and post-mortem analysis
